Clean appetising polished commercial food photograph.

Put exact heading "matcha latte" directly above the left cup and exact heading "strawberry matcha latte" directly above the right cup with tidy line breaks. Small "128am Cafe" at top centre. Palette cream #FFF8F5, rose #B8496C, subtle blush #FDE5EB and sage #E7F0DC. Typography consistent across a premium café catalogue. No other text, no prices, no claims, no watermark, no added toppings or fruit, no straw, no hands. ONE completed photograph.
